title: Collison Detected Properties
description: Detects vehicle collision events within a surveillance zone. Captures vehicle view, vehicle classification type, and zone information where the collision occurred. Use this event when queries involve accidents, crashes, impact detection, or vehicle collision analysis.

vehicle_view.description: View or orientation of the vehicle involved in the collision (e.g., front, rear, side).

type.description: Category or classification of the vehicle involved in the collision (e.g., car, truck, bus, two-wheeler).

zoneid.description: Identifier of the zone where the collision was detected.
